question: Which state government has passed a law providing 30 per cent horizontal reservation for resident women in the state in government jobs, in January 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttarakhand** state government passed a law providing **30 per cent horizontal reservation for resident women** in the state in government jobs in **January 2023**.
 
• This reservation aims to promote gender equality and empower women by ensuring adequate representation in government employment.
 
• The horizontal reservation is applicable **across all categories** including General, SC, ST, and OBC.
 
• This move is expected to significantly improve the employment opportunities for women in Uttarakhand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Uttarakhand government has been proactive in introducing policies that support women's empowerment and gender equality.
 
• In addition to job reservations, various schemes and initiatives have been launched to enhance women's education, health, and socio-economic status in the state.
 
• Such measures are part of a broader strategy to ensure inclusive development and equitable opportunities for all sections of society.
